services.name: Horseback Riding
services.desc: From hiking the dramatic Crack of Doom at Sulphur Gates to mountain biking the Griffiths Trail or exploring over 2,700 km of trails suited for everything from short walks to multi-day backpacking adventures, Greenview is an outdoor playground for every kind of explorer. Just south and east of Grande Prairie, a vast trail network and wilderness areas invite visitors to hike, fish, hunt, camp, snowmobile, ski, and ride all-terrain vehicles. Follow Highway 43 through a landscape rich in adventure, where agritourism, outdoor recreation, and natural beauty await at every turn Listed here are short descriptions of the most popular walks and day hikes, as well as the Canadian Death Race trails.
